request: What are the costs of federal student loan forgiveness programs such as Public Service Loan Forgiveness?

reply.reply:
**CRS describes student-loan forgiveness as mandatory loan-subsidy spending; PSLF discharged $36.3 billion from July 1, 2022-June 30, 2023, including Limited PSLF Waiver benefits.**

- PSLF is mandatory spending included in loan subsidy costs; $36.3 billion was discharged or repaid from July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, including benefits under the Limited PSLF Waiver. (R43571, PDF p. 42)
- Federal direct-loan costs are measured as estimated long-term net-present-value costs and attributed to the fiscal year when the loan obligation is made. (R43571, PDF p. 31)
- Qualified-borrower forgiveness entitlements are generally funded through mandatory appropriations and included in federal student-loan subsidy costs. (R47837, PDF p. 4)
reply.reasoning: CRS says qualified forgiveness entitlements are generally funded through mandatory appropriations and included in federal student-loan subsidy costs. The cited PSLF amount covers the specified year and includes Limited PSLF Waiver benefits.
